fields.help_en:
The departure and arrival city codes. Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas.
If you pass 0, city control is not applied. When using this value, pay attention to the parameters for hotel travel standards and ensure that travel standards are passed for all cities.
When the transportation mode traffic_type is set to 0, 6, 21, or 25, you can pass the 3-letter airport code or the 6-digit city code. For other enum values, pass the 6-digit city code.
The departure and arrival cities city_set and the departure and arrival city codes city_code_set must have a one-to-one mapping.

<warning>If the transportation mode traffic_type includes flights and the specified city does not have an airport, flight tickets cannot be booked.</warning>

Business travel city data:
3-letter airport code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)
6-digit city code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
fields.help_zh:

当交通方式 `traffic_type` 传入 0/6/21/25 时，可传机场三字码或城市六位码。其他枚举值请传城市六位码。
离抵城市 `city_set` 和离抵城市code `city_code_set` 必须一对一。

<warning>当交通方式 `traffic_type` 包含飞机时，如果给到的城市无机场，则不可预订机票。></warning>
